title: Eclipse Monarch
summary: Guardian of rank S · level 18 · 1,500 HP.

blocks.text: Eclipse Monarch is a rift guardian: the last fight of a dungeon of rank S. 15% chance to blink behind its target when hit.

blocks.text: These are the monster's own values. In a dungeon they are multiplied by the rank of the rift and by the number of awakened inside: see Dungeon formulas . The game has no elemental weaknesses or resistances.

blocks.text: A guardian gets angrier as it loses health: every new phase makes it faster (speed ×1.08, wind-ups ×0.92, cooldowns ×0.88), opens a new attack from phase 2 on and a signature attack from rank C. The number of phases depends on the rank of the dungeon (2 at rank E up to 6 at rank Nation). See Monsters overview .
